character: Sunny southern Alps resort in a larch forest overlooking Lac de Serre-Ponçon. 100km pistes, 3 snow fronts (1550, 1650, 1800), family-friendly, 10 hamlets. Southern climate with reliable snow from NW exposure.
description: Les Orres sits in a larch forest in the Hautes-Alpes with panoramic views of Lac de Serre-Ponçon and the Écrins National Park. 3 snow fronts at different altitudes (1550, 1650, 1800). 100km of pistes, 36 runs (9 green, 5 blue, 17 red, 5 black), 17 lifts. North-western exposure preserves snow quality despite southern climate. Open 5 December 2026 to 11 April 2027.

non_ski_activities.snow_fronts: 3 altitude levels: Les Orres 1550, 1650, and 1800 — each with different character and access.
non_ski_activities.bars_and_restaurants: Le Gîte 05 (dinner-shows, traditional, open 7/7), Le Lieu (bistronomic, views of larch forest), Le Curious (lounge bar and tapas), Carrefour Montagne bakery.
non_ski_activities.entertainment: Free evening entertainment programme, drone show (24 December), torchlight descents (30 December), New Year celebrations.
non_ski_activities.activities: Snowpark, 2 toboggan areas (1650 and 1800), snowshoeing, paragliding, fitness, climbing, virtual reality, guided walks.
non_ski_activities.kids: 2 snow gardens, Kids Park, free activities, ESF and ESI ski schools.
non_ski_activities.events: Winter Opening weekend (5-6 Dec), Magic Christmas (19-25 Dec), Drone Show (24 Dec), New Year celebrations, Mountain Film Library Encounters.
non_ski_activities.location_note: Near Embrun and Lac de Serre-Ponçon. Easy reach from Marseille, Aix-en-Provence, Gap, Briançon.

honest_drawbacks: Southern Alps — less reliable snow than northern Alps despite good exposure
Quiet apres compared to big-name resorts
